services.name: Salmon Fishing
services.desc: Salmon are the most popular Showtime Charters trips. When salmon move into Grand Traverse Bay later in the summer, the action can be exciting, memorable, and perfect for anglers looking for a hard-fighting fish. Salmon typically become the main focus from late July through the end of the fishing season. Grand Traverse Bay is one of Northern Michigan’s most beautiful places to fish, and salmon season brings a special kind of excitement to the water. These trips are popular with experienced anglers, vacationing families, and guests who want the thrill of battling a powerful fish. Showtime Charters helps make the experience comfortable and approachable. You do not need to be an expert to enjoy
